# Frontend engineering

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

The web client of a product: the HTML, the CSS, and the JavaScript that run in the browser. Here, the frontend lane makes the core of each page work first, and measures the experience of real users.

## References

- You measure or improve the speed of a web page. Read [Core Web Vitals](core-web-vitals.md).
- You build the core content or a core function of a page. Read [Progressive enhancement](progressive-enhancement.md).
